    67  otError NetworkData::GetNetworkData(bool aStable, uint8_t *aData, uint8_t &aDataLength)
    68  {
    69      otError error = OT_ERROR_NONE;
    70
    71      assert(aData != NULL);
    72      VerifyOrExit(aDataLength >= mLength, error = OT_ERROR_NO_BUFS);
    73
    74      memcpy(aData, mTlvs, mLength);
    75      aDataLength = mLength;
    76
    77      if (aStable)
    78      {
    79          RemoveTemporaryData(aData, aDataLength);
    80      }
    81
    82  exit:
    83      return error;
    84  }

    61  /**
    62   * This class implements Thread Network Data TLV generation and parsing.
    63   *
    64   */
    65  OT_TOOL_PACKED_BEGIN
    66  class NetworkDataTlv
    67  {
    68  public:
    69      /**
    70       * This method initializes TLV.
    71       *
    72       */
    73      void Init(void)
    74      {
    75          mType   = 0;
    76          mLength = 0;
    77      }
    78
    79      /**
    80       * Thread Network Data Type values.
    81       *
    82       */
    83      enum Type
    84      {
    85          kTypeHasRoute          = 0, ///< Has Route TLV
    86          kTypePrefix            = 1, ///< Prefix TLV
    87          kTypeBorderRouter      = 2, ///< Border Router TLV
    88          kTypeContext           = 3, ///< Context TLV
    89          kTypeCommissioningData = 4, ///< Commissioning Dataset TLV
    90          kTypeService           = 5, ///< Service TLV
    91          kTypeServer            = 6, ///< Server TLV
    92      };
    93
    94      /**
    95       * This method returns the Type value.
    96       *
    97       * @returns The Type value.
    98       *
    99       */
   100      Type GetType(void) const { return static_cast<Type>(mType >> kTypeOffset); }
   101
   102      /**
   103       * This method sets the Type value.
   104       *
   105       * @param[in]  aType  The Type value.
   106       *
   107       */
   108      void SetType(Type aType) { mType = (mType & ~kTypeMask) | ((aType << kTypeOffset) & kTypeMask); }
   109
   110      /**
   111       * This method returns the Length value.
   112       *
   113       * @returns The Length value.
   114       *
   115       */
   116      uint8_t GetLength(void) const { return mLength; }
   117
   118      /**
   119       * This method sets the Length value.
   120       *
   300       *
   301       * If there are no entries the pointer will be invalid but guaranteed to be before the `GetFirstEntry()` pointer.
   302       *
   303       * @returns A pointer to the last HasRouteEntry.
   304       *
   305       */
   306      HasRouteEntry *GetLastEntry(void)
   307      {
   308          return reinterpret_cast<HasRouteEntry *>(GetValue() + GetLength() - sizeof(HasRouteEntry));
   309      }
   310  } OT_TOOL_PACKED_END;

   312  /**
   313   * This class implements Prefix TLV generation and parsing.
   314   *
   315   */
   316  OT_TOOL_PACKED_BEGIN
   317  class PrefixTlv : public NetworkDataTlv
   318  {
   319  public:
   320      /**
   321       * This method initializes the TLV.
   322       *
   323       * @param[in]  aDomainId      The Domain ID.
   324       * @param[in]  aPrefixLength  The Prefix Length
   325       * @param[in]  aPrefix        A pointer to the prefix.
   326       *
   327       */
   328      void Init(uint8_t aDomainId, uint8_t aPrefixLength, const uint8_t *aPrefix)
   329      {
   330          NetworkDataTlv::Init();
   331          SetType(kTypePrefix);
   332          mDomainId     = aDomainId;
   333          mPrefixLength = aPrefixLength;
   334          memcpy(GetPrefix(), aPrefix, BitVectorBytes(aPrefixLength));
   335          SetSubTlvsLength(0);
   336      }
   337
   338      /**
   339       * This method indicates whether or not the TLV appears to be well-formed.
   340       *
   341       * @retval TRUE   If the TLV appears to be well-formed.
   342       * @retval FALSE  If the TLV does not appear to be well-formed.
   343       *
   344       */
   345      bool IsValid(void) const
   346      {
   347          return ((GetLength() >= sizeof(*this) - sizeof(NetworkDataTlv)) &&
   348                  (GetLength() >= BitVectorBytes(mPrefixLength) + sizeof(*this) - sizeof(NetworkDataTlv)));
   349      }
   350
   351      /**
   352       * This method returns the Domain ID value.
   353       *
   354       * @returns The Domain ID value.
   355       *
   356       */
   357      uint8_t GetDomainId(void) const { return mDomainId; }
   358
   359      /**
   360       * This method returns the Prefix Length value.
   361       *
   362       * @returns The Prefix Length value.
   363       *
   364       */
   365      uint8_t GetPrefixLength(void) const { return mPrefixLength; }
   366
   367      /**
   368       * This method returns a pointer to the Prefix.
   369       *
   370       * @returns A pointer to the Prefix.
   371       *
   372       */
   373      uint8_t *GetPrefix(void) { return reinterpret_cast<uint8_t *>(this) + sizeof(*this); }
   374
   375      /**
   376       * This method returns a pointer to the Sub-TLVs.
   377       *
   378       * @returns A pointer to the Sub-TLVs.
   379       *
   380       */
   381      NetworkDataTlv *GetSubTlvs(void)
   382      {
   383          return reinterpret_cast<NetworkDataTlv *>(GetPrefix() + BitVectorBytes(mPrefixLength));
   384      }
   385
   386      /**
   387       * This method returns the Sub-TLVs length in bytes.
   388       *
   389       * @returns The Sub-TLVs length in bytes.
   390       *
   391       */
   392      uint8_t GetSubTlvsLength(void) const
   393      {
   394          return GetLength() - (sizeof(*this) - sizeof(NetworkDataTlv) + BitVectorBytes(mPrefixLength));
   395      }
   396
   397      /**
   398       * This method sets the Sub-TLVs length in bytes.
   399       *
   400       * @param[in]  aLength  The Sub-TLVs length in bytes.
   401       *
   402       */
   403      void SetSubTlvsLength(uint8_t aLength)
   404      {
   405          SetLength(sizeof(*this) - sizeof(NetworkDataTlv) + BitVectorBytes(mPrefixLength) + aLength);
   406      }
   407
   408  private:
   409      uint8_t mDomainId;
   410      uint8_t mPrefixLength;
   411  } OT_TOOL_PACKED_END;

   413  /**
   414   * This class implements Border Router Entry generation and parsing.

   417  OT_TOOL_PACKED_BEGIN
   418  class BorderRouterEntry
   419  {
   420  public:
   421      enum
   422      {
   423          kPreferenceOffset = 6,
   424          kPreferenceMask   = 3 << kPreferenceOffset,
   425          kPreferredFlag    = 1 << 5,
   426          kSlaacFlag        = 1 << 4,
   427          kDhcpFlag         = 1 << 3,
   428          kConfigureFlag    = 1 << 2,
   429          kDefaultRouteFlag = 1 << 1,
   430          kOnMeshFlag       = 1 << 0,
   430          kOnMeshFlag       = 1 << 0,
   431      };
   432
   433      /**
   434       * This method initializes the TLV.
   435       *
   436       */
   437      void Init(void)
   438      {
   439          SetRloc(Mac::kShortAddrInvalid);
   440          mFlags    = 0;
   441          mReserved = 0;
   442      }
   443
   444      /**
   445       * This method returns the RLOC16 value.
   446       *
   447       * @returns The RLOC16 value.
   448       */
   449      uint16_t GetRloc(void) const { return HostSwap16(mRloc); }
   450
   451      /**
   452       * This method sets the RLOC16 value.
   453       *
   454       * @param[in]  aRloc16  The RLOC16 value.
   455       *
   456       */
   457      void SetRloc(uint16_t aRloc16) { mRloc = HostSwap16(aRloc16); }
   458
   459      /**
   460       * This method returns the Flags byte value.
   461       *
   462       * @returns The Flags byte value.
   463       *
   464       */
   465      uint8_t GetFlags(void) const { return mFlags & ~kPreferenceMask; }
   466
   467      /**
   468       * This method sets the Flags byte value.
   469       *
   470       * @param[in]  aFlags  The Flags byte value.
   471       *
   472       */
   473      void SetFlags(uint8_t aFlags) { mFlags = (mFlags & kPreferenceMask) | (aFlags & ~kPreferenceMask); }
   474
   475      /**
   476       * This method returns the Preference value.
   477       *
   478       * @returns the Preference value.
   479       *
   480       */
   481      int8_t GetPreference(void) const { return static_cast<int8_t>(mFlags) >> kPreferenceOffset; }
   482
   483      /**
   484       * This method sets the Preference value.
   485       *
   486       * @param[in]  aPrf  The Preference value.
   487       *
   488       */
   489      void SetPreference(int8_t aPrf)
   490      {
   491          mFlags = (mFlags & ~kPreferenceMask) | ((static_cast<uint8_t>(aPrf) << kPreferenceOffset) & kPreferenceMask);
   492      }
   493
   494      /**
   495       * This method indicates whether or not the Preferred flag is set.
   496       *
   497       * @retval TRUE   If the Preferred flag is set.
   498       * @retval FALSE  If the Preferred flag is not set.
   499       *
   500       */
   501      bool IsPreferred(void) const { return (mFlags & kPreferredFlag) != 0; }
   502
   503      /**
   504       * This method clears the Preferred flag.
   505       *
   506       */
   507      void ClearPreferred(void) { mFlags &= ~kPreferredFlag; }
   508
   509      /**
   510       * This method sets the Preferred flag.
   511       *
   512       */
   513      void SetPreferred(void) { mFlags |= kPreferredFlag; }
   514
   515      /**
   516       * This method indicates whether or not the SLAAC flag is set.
   517       *
   518       * @retval TRUE   If the SLAAC flag is set.
   519       * @retval FALSE  If the SLAAC flag is not set.
   520       *
   521       */
   522      bool IsSlaac(void) const { return (mFlags & kSlaacFlag) != 0; }
   523
   524      /**
   525       * This method clears the SLAAC flag.
   526       *
   527       */
   528      void ClearSlaac(void) { mFlags &= ~kSlaacFlag; }
   529
   530      /**
   531       * This method sets the SLAAC flag.
   532       *
   533       */
   534      void SetSlaac(void) { mFlags |= kSlaacFlag; }
   535
   536      /**
   537       * This method indicates whether or not the DHCP flag is set.
   538       *
   539       * @retval TRUE   If the DHCP flag is set.
   540       * @retval FALSE  If the DHCP flag is not set.
